kypExtensions.rationale: Framing the membrane as a dam (I/III/IV pumps, ATP-synthase turbine, uncoupler floodgates) and the two cofactor entries as full-price vs side-door docks is a KYP-original scaffold over the source's separate statements.
kypExtensions.summary: The dam model that unifies pumping, the gradient, the single return turbine, and the two leak paths (brown fat, aspirin) into one causal machine with the 2.5-vs-1.5 pricing rule.
